texts.error.archive_unreadable: The game's archive %1 cannot be read.
texts.error.bad_dip: The dip switch setting '%1' = '%2' is not one %3 has (its switches: %4 groups).
texts.error.disc_unreadable: The disc image %1 cannot be read. It must be a .cue sheet with every track file it names beside it, or a .chd.
texts.error.needs_bios: A Neo Geo needs its bios set, neogeo.zip. Add it as the project's Neo Geo Bios Set firmware.
texts.error.neocd_bios_missing: A Neo Geo CD needs its BIOS sets, neocdz.zip and neogeo.zip. %1 is missing: add it as the project's firmware.
texts.error.neocd_not_started: FBNeo could not start the Neo Geo CD: its bios is missing or wrong (the log names the rom). It needs neocd.bin from neocdz.zip and 000-lo.lo from neogeo.zip.
texts.error.no_disc: No disc: the project's Disc slot is empty.
texts.error.no_set: No rom set: the project's Rom set slot is empty.
texts.error.not_started: FBNeo could not start %1: a rom is missing or wrong (the log names it). A clone needs its parent's set, and a Neo Geo game the bios set.
texts.error.path_too_long: The disc image's path is too long: %1
texts.error.save_not_kept: The save data %1: %2 keeps no such thing.
texts.error.save_size: The save data %1 is the wrong size for %2.
texts.error.unknown_set: No CPS-1, CPS-2, CPS-3, Neo Geo or System 16 game is called '%1'. The rom set must keep FBNeo's name for it (%1.zip).
texts.error.wrong_machine: The project says %1, but %2 is a %3 game. Pick %3 in the New Project wizard's System box.
texts.firmware.neocdz_zip.about: The Neo Geo CD's BIOS set, in the file FBNeo calls neocdz.zip. It holds neocd.bin, the console's own BIOS, and any replacement BIOS the console's BIOS setting can choose. The whole zip is given to the core, which picks ROMs by their checksums. The console also needs neogeo.zip, for a graphics ROM (000-lo.lo) it shares with the cartridge machine.
texts.firmware.neogeo_zip.about: The Neo Geo's BIOS set, in the file FBNeo calls neogeo.zip. It holds the MVS and AES BIOS ROMs, the sound processor's BIOS and two graphics ROMs. The whole zip is given to the core, which picks the ROMs it needs by their checksums. No size or hash is required, because sets differ in what they contain.
texts.game_setting.dip: A dip switch of this game's board: '%1'. The game reads it as part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value to play back. The default is the driver's.
texts.note.console_switches: The console's switches are below, each at FBNeo's default: its region, its bios, and how fast it loads from the disc (FBNeo's default is faster than the console was).
texts.note.dips: This game's dip switches are below, each at the driver's default.
texts.note.no_dips: This game has no dip switches (a CPS-2 game keeps its settings in its EEPROM, set in its service menu).
texts.setting.cpu_clock.about: The speed of the main processor, as a percentage of the real board's (FBNeo's CPU clock setting). Above 100 a game slows down less in busy scenes, and below 100 it slows down more. It changes how the game runs, so a movie needs the same value. It works on CPS-1, CPS-2, Neo Geo and System 16. CPS-3 ignores it.
texts.setting.fm_interpolation.about: How FBNeo converts the sound of the boards' FM chips (YM2151, YM2610) to the output rate. It affects the sound only, like Sample Interpolation. The default is FBNeo's own.
texts.setting.force_60hz.about: Runs a board whose picture rate is close to 60 Hz (59.18 on the Neo Geo, 59.63 on CPS-1 and CPS-2) at exactly 60 Hz. The game then runs slightly faster and its sound changes, so it is part of the machine.
texts.setting.machine.about: Which machine this project is. It is either an arcade board (Capcom's CPS-1, CPS-2 or CPS-3, SNK's Neo Geo MVS, Sega's System 16A or 16B) or SNK's Neo Geo CD console. A board's game is a ROM set, and it must be a set for that board. A set for another board is refused with a message that names the right board. The Neo Geo CD's game is a disc image. Each machine has its own controls.
texts.setting.neogeo_bios.about: Which BIOS the Neo Geo starts with. It can be an MVS (arcade) BIOS of a certain region and version, an AES (home console) BIOS, or a UniBIOS. The BIOS decides the region, the language and whether the game runs as its arcade or its home version, so it is part of the machine. It must be in the project's neogeo.zip. The default is FBNeo's own.
texts.setting.pcm_interpolation.about: How FBNeo converts the sound of the boards' sample chips (QSound, the MSM6295 and similar) to the output rate. It affects the sound only. The game runs the same, and a movie plays back with any value. The default is FBNeo's own.
texts.setting.socd.about: What the game receives when a player holds opposite directions at once (Left and Right, or Up and Down). 'off' passes both on to the game. 'neutral' cancels both. The other choices let one direction win (the last one pressed, the first one pressed, or up over down). A real joystick cannot press both, and the default (FBNeo's own, last input wins, 8-way) matches what a person with a stick can do. 'off' lets a movie do what no stick can.
texts.slot.disc.help: The Neo Geo CD game. It is either a .cue file or a .chd file. The track files (.bin) named in a .cue join the project automatically and must be in the same folder. A disc stored as a zip has to be unpacked first.
texts.slot.romset.help: The game's ROM set comes first, with the file name FBNeo uses (for example ssf2t.zip). The name is how the core knows which game it is. A clone's set holds only the files that differ from its parent, so add the parent's set after it (a clone of ssf2t also needs ssf2t.zip). Each ROM is found by its checksum first and by its name second.
texts.slot.savedata.help: What a game keeps when the power is off, in the files Export Save Data wrote. These are the Neo Geo's NVRAM.bin and Memory_card.bin, the EEPROM of a CPS-2 or CPS-3 board, and the Neo Geo CD's backup memory. Each file is put back where it came from before the first frame.
